spans.s:
ind. 
__1 A particle of affirmation, even, just, only; यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसद् [[

.]] especially in strengthening a statement; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं भद्रमश्नुते [[Nir.]] 
__2 It is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion: विश्व इत् एक इत् &c. 
__3 At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions &c. (its place is taken by एव in classical Sanskrit).
